rows.Kwic: 知心與境本不相到，當處解脫。一一諸法，當處寂滅，當處道場。又本有之性，不可名目。
rows.sourceTitle: 百丈懷海禪師廣錄（四家語錄卷三）

Override.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Baizhang Huaihai (百丈懷海禪師廣錄（四家語錄卷三）): in his extensive record, Baizhang Huaihai enumerates liberation, quiescence, and the teaching place right there.
